newsitem.title: USA: Investor raises stake in DVI.
newsitem.headline: Investor raises stake in DVI.

text.p: New York investor Ronald Baron said Wednesday he raised his stake in DVI Inc to 20.8 percent, or 2,181,850 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Baron said that firms under his control bought 175,500 additional shares of DVI between October 17 and December 17 at prices ranging from $12.625 to $14.4741 a share.
Baron, who previously held a 19.6 percent stake in DVI, said the shares were purchased for investment. Baron is president of Baron Capital Management Inc, a New York-based investment firm.
DVI is a Doylestown, Pa.,-based finance company that specializes in financing acquisitoin of sophisticated medical equipment such as those used for diagnostic imaging and radiation therapy.
